# GES_industrial -- Final Results

**GES** on **Industrial (TEP)**. Generated by `tools/write_final_results.py` from this folder's `outputs/`; every figure below is read from the files the run wrote, never transcribed.


## Detection performance

The threshold is the 95th percentile of the fault-free score distribution, computed without reference to any attack label. AUC-ROC is the primary metric because it is threshold-free; F1 is reported at that fixed operating point and is only comparable against other rows measured the same way.

| Variant | TP | FP | TN | FN | Precision | Recall | F1 | AUC-ROC | AUC-PR |
| :--- | ---: | ---: | ---: | ---: | ---: | ---: | ---: | ---: | ---: |
| Linear / Ridge | 950 | 4 | 59 | 310 | 0.9958 | 0.7540 | **0.8582** | **0.8407** | 0.9915 |
| Polynomial degree 3 | 945 | 4 | 59 | 315 | 0.9958 | 0.7500 | **0.8556** | **0.8849** | 0.9939 |
| RBF + Ridge | 1019 | 4 | 59 | 241 | 0.9961 | 0.8087 | **0.8927** | **0.8994** | 0.9948 |

Best by AUC-ROC: **RBF + Ridge** at **0.8994**, over 1323 evaluated samples.

These values match the other two algorithms on this dataset. Only the causal discovery method and the regression type differ across folders; see the root `README.md` section 6.

### Coherence against the documented TEP fault table

| Fault | Documented cause | Expected | Top-ranked | Match |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :---: |
| 4 | Reactor cooling water inlet temperature, step | `XMV_10` | `XMV_10` | yes |
| 5 | Condenser cooling water inlet temperature, step | `XMV_11` | `XMV_5` | no |
| 7 | C header pressure loss | `XMV_4` | `XMV_5` | no |
| 11 | Reactor cooling water, random variation | `XMV_10` | `XMV_10` | yes |
| 14 | Reactor cooling water valve sticking | `XMV_10` | `XMEAS_21` | no |

**2 of 5 faults localised to the exact variable named in the fault specification** (linear variant, top-ranked attribution only). Detection strength and root-cause specificity are separate properties and do not have to agree.


## Reproducing

```bash
cd GES/GES_industrial
python anomaly_detection_ges.py
python anomaly_detection_ges_polynomial.py
python anomaly_detection_ges_rbf.py
```

The first run learns and caches the causal graph; later runs reuse it. Delete the `.npz` cache to force rediscovery. The scripts refuse to run against a cache whose resampling rate disagrees with the code, so a stale cache fails loudly instead of reporting metrics for a pipeline that no longer exists.
